scope: S5 replacement-ANN locomotion only; no connectome claim, no injury experiment
base_status: supervised on filtered measured motion; open-loop it collapses (support .607, non-foot 31.45 W, slip max 1.139)

residual.action_joints: tibia pitch of all six legs, one per leg

reward.slip_hinge: 2.0 * sum_i max(0, r_i - 0.35)^2 with r_i = vt_i / max(|filtered_forward|, 0.05)
reward.termination: COM height < 0.95 or non-foot force > 0.05 W

level_gates.note: gates are the frozen acceptance quantities; my evaluator recomputes them, it is not the frozen D-gate suite, and that is stated in every result file

failure_policy: if a level fails its gates after the allocated updates, the run stops at that level and the failure is reported with the measured numbers; no gate, bound or reward weight is adjusted to force a pass
accounting: every run reports native physics steps, policy ticks and wall time; no hidden drive, no root/pose write, no external oscillator

amendment_1.reason: smoke test measured about 38 s wall time per update (rollout 256 at 5 ms ticks = 1.28 s simulated, plus a pure-numpy PPO pass), so 32 updates x 4 levels would exceed the remaining session budget
amendment_1.change: updates_per_level 32 -> 16; every other number, weight, bound, gate and threshold is unchanged
amendment_1.kept_unchanged: reward definition, action space, curriculum targets, level gates, frozen acceptance thresholds

amendment_2.reason: level 0 stopped after 16 updates at a stable-but-sliding local optimum (support 1.0003, non-foot 0.0, forward 0.051, but slip 1.64-3.87 and COM 0.866): it learned to stand without falling instead of to plant feet
amendment_2.change: extend level 0 to 48 updates in total, continuing from the saved weights; no reward weight, action bound, curriculum target, gate or threshold changes
amendment_2.hypothesis_before_running: if the metric-matched slip hinge can pull the policy out of the standing local optimum, per-leg slip should fall below 1.0; if it stays above 1.5 after 32 more updates the standing optimum is what this reward/action space actually rewards
